{{Top|leg}}
A '''tele-eye''' was a single-barrel, hand-held optical device which magnified distant objects in day or night. The scope provided azimuth information (true and relative) of an object, as well as elevation and ranging information. It functioned on the same principle as [[Macrobinoculars/Legends|macrobinoculars]].
